tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: Search this endpoint's catalog of business connectivity, voice and managed-IT services. Matches query text against service names and descriptions, with an optional exact category filter. Returns up to limit services (default 25, max 100) with id, name, category, provider and pricing; price detail de

tools.name: catalog.get
tools.description: Get full details for one catalog service by service_id (from catalog.search): name, description, category, provider, pricing and its order schema. Price detail depends on your access tier. Read-only; no API key needed.

tools.name: catalog.order_schema.get
tools.description: Get the order schema for one catalog service by service_id: whether agents can order it and the configuration a quote.request payload must satisfy. Read-only; no API key needed. Call it before quote.request so the request validates.

tools.name: order.draft
tools.description: Draft an order from one of your confirmed quotes. The signer named on your mandate is asked to sign in. No checkout URL is returned.

tools.name: quote.request
tools.description: Request a price quote for one catalog service (service_id from catalog.search). Needs an API key with a quote mandate from your owner; the mandate's spending ceiling and daily quote limits apply. Repeating a client_reference returns the same quote instead of a new one. Supply configuration per catal

tools.name: quote.get
tools.description: Get one of your quotes: status, lines, totals, validity, and order id once ordered.

tools.name: quote.cancel
tools.description: Cancel one of your own open quotes by quote_id. Needs an API key with a quote mandate from your owner. Another agent's quote returns quote_not_found. Returns the quote_id and its new status.

tools.name: cart.draft.create
tools.description: Create a cart draft for a scoped, agent-orderable service. Requires caller-managed session_id.

tools.name: order.get
tools.description: Get one of your orders: status, amounts, paperwork profile, envelope status and timestamps, signed time, signer name, and timeline. Does not include the signer's email or a signing URL.

tools.name: availability.check
tools.description: Check which suppliers can likely serve a US business address, with honest status (likely | unknown | confirmed | not_available), the evidence source, and the price you are allowed to see. FCC BDC mass-market speeds are lower bounds, not business maximums or address-specific guarantees. FCC data only

tools.name: mandate.get
tools.description: List the mandates your owner has issued to you: which actions (browse, availability_check, quote, draft_order), which categories, the monthly commitment ceiling, and when each expires.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order.get · Private data: catalog.search, catalog.get, catalog.order_schema.get, quote.request, quote.cancel · Public sink: order.get.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order.get · Private data: catalog.search, catalog.get, catalog.order_schema.get, quote.request, quote.cancel · Public sink: order.get

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "catalog.search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search scoped catalog" → after: "Search this endpoint's catalog of business connectivity, voice and managed-IT services. Matches query text against service names and descriptions, with an optional exact category filter. Returns up to limit services (default 25, max 100) with id, name, category, provider and pricing; price detail de"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
